why: Tier-1 tooling: scripts/ops/render_due_list.py plus ONE new test file (tests/test_due_list_id_safe_truncation.py). No src/, no config/, no deploy/, no workflows, no registers touched — NOT in LANDING_MACHINERY, so R12 does not apply, and that was verified by importing the tuple and testing both paths against it rather than by eye. WHAT IT FIXES: render_due_list.py truncated register prose with a bare [:200], so on 2026-09-12 a cut landed inside a filed id and every DUE.json/DUE.md since carried a 37-character prefix of a real row — a reference resolving to nothing. check_backlog_refs.py then correctly refused the commit, so the due-list PRODUCER generated output its own repo could never accept and DUE.json froze at 2026-09-13T05:20 for four days. This is the EARLIER of the two causes and the only one continuous across the whole window: measured on four automation PRs spanning 09-13 to 09-17, each with a resolvable base ref and its added-line count reported first so no verdict is read off an empty diff, all four exit 1 on the same fragment. open-items-guard, the other candidate, only went red on 09-16 and explains one day of four. THE FIX is _clip(text, limit) at 11 sites: the whole id, or none of it. Its one over-limit branch (an id at offset 0 longer than the limit) is deliberate and documented — a long line is a readability cost, a fragment is a dangling reference. The prefix vocabulary is a COPY of the guard's REF rather than an import, so that a CI guard's module-scope work stays off the renderer's hot path, and a test parses REF out of the guard and fails on drift — the only failure a copied constant has. CONTROLS: 14 tests, six planted defects, five reddened at once. THE SIXTH WAS ABSORBED and is recorded rather than quietly re-plugged: deleting the boundary check that preserves a COMPLETE trailing id changed nothing, because no test constructed a cut landing at the end of an id; without it _clip discards valid references, the opposite failure and equally wrong. A test now builds that input and the re-plant reddens. One structural test forbids the IDIOM rather than these 11 sites, and its exemption is DERIVED — 13 is the shortest string REF can match, re-derived from the guard by its own test — not a tuned threshold, which is also what keeps it off list slices like added[:5]. END-TO-END, not asserted from the harness: the regenerated artifact plus the REAL guard exits 0 after and 1 before, and exactly one id left the artifact (128 -> 127 unique, -38 bytes). THE REGENERATED DUE.json/DUE.md ARE DELIBERATELY NOT IN THE DIFF though they proved the fix — landing a hand-rendered register races the cron and can rewind main with a superseded artifact, which is the exact hazard this lane flagged to the manager about the 36 stranded automation PRs. AND WRITING THE DOCSTRING RE-CREATED THE FINDING IT EXPLAINS: check_backlog_refs scans scripts/ too, so the literal fragment made this file dangle; the examples carry no date digits and a note says why, so a later reader does not restore them.
